message:
monday is actually a good night to be in [canggu](kebi://area/id/bali/canggu), here's how i'd play it from your saves

start at [Luigi's](kebi://venue/c59914af-38a0-499e-8d5a-b3416eb2ed3e), that's the one to anchor your monday around. they do house and techno nights specifically on mondays, pizza plus a proper dj, and it's 7:30 now so the energy is just starting to build. that's your first move.

then walk over to [Old Man's](kebi://venue/45a09352-bfd6-403a-b5c5-7b23699a1ce2), it's right there on batu bolong and runs every night of the week. classic beach bar energy, good for a drink between spots, easy backpacker vibe.

if you want to keep going after that, [Sand Bar](kebi://venue/f01f4435-631c-41e9-a3a9-f05356eb82c2) does afterparties every day, beachfront, cocktails, easy end to the night.

[Bella.](kebi://venue/3685d4ef-00be-4d91-9933-d82cf94b5315) is also worth knowing about, it's on berawa and turns into a house and techno spot at night too, so if luigi's gets too packed you've got a backup with the same vibe.

skip for tonight:
- [Vault](kebi://venue/7861b346-2a73-4a7a-a66c-b58840527758) is wed to sat only, not tonight
- [The Mesa](kebi://venue/968ba4ad-fc09-4365-8d69-dac6358c1722) is a friday spot
- [Motel Mexicola](kebi://venue/8099938c-7730-4890-93e1-bd333d3a8ffa) is tuesday's big night, you're one day early
- [La Favela](kebi://venue/c00a6f5c-20d4-4955-924b-41a38a3fc9d8) is over in seminyak, not worth the ride when your monday is this sorted in canggu

luigi's then old man's then sand bar, your monday is set.
